item.text: {"hypothesis_status":"not_supported","summary":"L007 executed successfully and passed the fixed G01 positive-Tc guard (8.4615 K <= 8.8322 K), but it was not an eligible improvement. Its pooled weighted OOF MAE was 7.7612 K versus A05's 7.7526 K, a deterioration of 0.0086 K; an eligible gain required MAE below 7.7426 K. Relative to A05, positive-Tc MAE improved from 8.5051 K to 8.4615 K, but reported-zero MAE worsened from 6.0806 K to 6.2051 K, while high-Tc MAE was unchanged at 28.8502 K because the cu_o expert was unchanged. Thus, hist_gradient_boosting/raw on the other route produced a near-incumbent subgroup tradeoff, not a guard-eligible pooled win.","next_action":"continue","next_focus":"Because the required successful-unique-cycle minimum remains pending, test an untried model-only perturbation of A05 on the problematic cu_o route: composition input, chemistry routing, global extra_trees/raw, cu_o hist_gradient_boosting/raw, and other extra_trees/raw, with fe_anion falling back globally. A04 suggests that hist_gradient_boosting/raw for cu_o can improve positive- and high-Tc errors while worsening reported-zero error, but A04 confounded that change with a separately fitted fe_anion expert. This focused configuration isolates the cu_o estimator while preserving A05's successful other expert and fe_anion fallback. It is falsified as an eligible improvement unless pooled weighted OOF MAE is below 7.742598770753422 K and positive-Tc MAE remains at or below 8.832165507919859 K; subgroup gains without both conditions remain tradeoffs.","stop_reason":"","limitations":["All measurements are adaptive development evidence from reused fixed-group training OOF folds, not independent validation or proof of generalization.","L007 passed the guard but failed the pooled improvement threshold, so it cannot replace A05.","Chemistry routes are operational composition partitions rather than verified physical material families.","The cu_o route has only 66 groups and retains severe ambiguity, including large overpredictions for reported-zero materials and large underpredictions for high-Tc materials.","Many allowed configurations remain untried, and these results neither establish generalization nor identify new superconductors."]}
